infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Duna Pro uses the camera to photograph products, scan check-ins, and support club operations.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Duna Pro uses the microphone only when a coach records a LiveKit session note.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Duna Pro uses selected photos for product and member media.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Duna Pro uses location for secure in-person payment readers and, when you choose, a private session arrival reminder active only from 60 minutes before until 30 minutes after start time.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: After you choose a session arrival reminder, background location keeps the coach Lock Screen ETA current only during the private arrival window. Duna Pro stops it automatically 30 minutes after start.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Duna Pro uses Bluetooth to connect to supported payment readers.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: Duna Pro uses Bluetooth to connect to supported payment readers.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Duna Pro uses the local network to connect to supported payment readers.
